beats.text: In nineteen twelve, the Titanic sank on her first voyage. But she was not alone.
beats.visual_objective: Illustrate: In nineteen twelve, the Titanic sank on her first voyage. But she was not alone.

beats.text: Her twin sister, the Olympic, sailed for twenty four more years.
beats.visual_objective: Illustrate: Her twin sister, the Olympic, sailed for twenty four more years.

beats.text: Why did one ship die, and the other survive?
beats.visual_objective: Illustrate: Why did one ship die, and the other survive?

beats.text: After the disaster, the Olympic was rebuilt with a second hull.
beats.visual_objective: Illustrate: After the disaster, the Olympic was rebuilt with a second hull.

beats.text: That hidden wall of steel is why she earned the name Old Reliable.
beats.visual_objective: Illustrate: That hidden wall of steel is why she earned the name Old Reliable.

beats.text: Would you have sailed on her? Tell me in the comments.
